official.deadline_note: The only deadline published on the official pages is the Fall 2026 application submission deadline of 15 February 2026, which has passed; E-JUST has not yet published dates for the next cycle. The full Fall 2026 timeline: primary screening announcement 19 March 2026, online interview and exams 29 March - 2 April 2026, result announcement 30 April 2026, deadline for original embassy-certified certificates 31 May 2026, arrival 18 September 2026, lectures start 27 September 2026. E-JUST states the schedule is subject to change.
official.application_cycle: Fall 2026 semester (the cycle published on the E-JUST site); the next cycle had not been announced as of 2026-10-10
official.status_note: The official site still publishes the Fall 2026 international admission timeline only, and that window closed on 15 February 2026 with the semester starting 27 September 2026; no new application dates are published as of 2026-10-10. On 14 June 2026 E-JUST announced the launch of the successor TICAD 9 African Scholarship and Postdoctoral Fellowship for STI, running September 2026 to September 2031, which also covers M.Sc. and PhD scholarships, short-term research visits to Japan for PhD students, and postdoctoral fellowships.
official.tuition_coverage_note: E-JUST states: 'E-JUST TICAD8 scholarship is a fully funded scholarship that covers: Tuition fees, Accommodation, Monthly stipend, Medical care, International Flight Fare (Round Tickets; from and to the applicant's home country).' The official TICAD8 flyer lists the same items as 'Tuition Fees, Accommodation, Monthly Stipend, Medical Insurance, Flight Tickets - Fully Funded Scholarships'.
benefits: International flight fare (round tickets; from and to the applicant's home country)
Six months of preparatory courses where necessary
eligibility: Applicants shall be researchers or instructors (or potentially expected to become those) who need to obtain their M.Sc. degree in the fields of Science or Engineering or other specialization
Applicant must be a holder of nationality of a country in Africa except for Egypt
Applicant must have a current home address in an African country
Applicant must not be serving in the military
Applicants should fulfill all the admission requirements and pass the academic interview and oral examination

Applicants who shall continue their jobs in their home universities or institutions after completion of their postgraduate program at E-JUST are preferable; in this case endorsement of the application form by the home institution is required
requirements: Bachelor's degree in the field of specialization with CGPA at least 3 out of 4 / very good / second class upper or equivalent; academic background must match the programme's academic background tables

English proficiency: TOEFL iBT minimum 79 or Academic IELTS minimum 6.5 for full-time students (certificate must be valid at the time of application); provisional acceptance requires Duolingo English Test 125, TOEFL iBT 65 or Academic IELTS 5.5 plus a mandatory English course in the preparatory year
Pass the personal and academic interview (minimum acceptance percentage 60%) and the oral examination

Equivalency certificate from the Egyptian Supreme Council of Universities and security clearance from the Ministry of Interior Affairs; E-JUST applies on behalf of applicants who pass the interview and oral examination, and failure to acquire either leads to termination of the application
Endorsement of the application form by the home institution for applicants who will return to work there
Full-time study only: scholarship holders must devote themselves fully to study and research and are not allowed to work elsewhere during the scholarship period
documents: Research proposal on the research area chosen from the application form, with a PowerPoint copy for the interview
Statement of purpose and most recent updated CV
B.Sc. certificate and B.Sc. transcript (transcript must include the grading system; both sides front and back scanned)
B.Sc. graduation project in full (not summarized) - mandatory for Faculty of Engineering applicants
Two academic recommendation letters from professors or ex-advisors in the applicant's affiliating university/academic institution
Endorsement letter signed and stamped by the affiliated institution for applicants who apply as teaching or research assistants and will continue their jobs at home institutions
selection_criteria: Knowledge of basic principles in the field (oral examination)
Research ability and potential, and potential for conducting independent experiments/surveys
Presentation skills and originality of the presentation in the research proposal defence
Logic and clearness in exposing ideas and in answering questions
Personal character, motivation and neatness; awards and publications are also considered
coverage: International round-trip airfare from and to the applicant's home country
application_method: Click 'Apply now' available through the international admission tab at the E-JUST website and fill in the online application
Attach all of the required documents to the online application form
Sit the online personal and academic interview and oral examination as scheduled by E-JUST
official.application_route: Online application through the international admission tab on ejust.edu.eg with all required documents attached, followed by screening, an online interview and oral examination.
official.citizenship_residency: Holder of the nationality of a country in Africa except for Egypt, with a current home address in an African country; applicants serving in the military are not eligible
official.international_eligibility: Yes - the scholarship is for nationals of African countries other than Egypt (non-Egyptian international students)
official.subject_or_agency_requirement: M.Sc. in the fields of Engineering, Computer Science and Information Technology, Basic and Applied Sciences, International Business and Humanities, or Heritage Science; the applicant's academic background must match the academic background tables of the chosen programme
official.research_requirement: A research proposal about the chosen research area must be attached to the application; the candidate presents it in a 15-minute PowerPoint presentation followed by a 25-minute discussion with the evaluation committee
official.duration: The scholarship's term is the period necessary to complete the degree requirements, which should be two years for the M.Sc. degree in addition to six months of preparatory courses (if necessary); the maximum period to complete the M.Sc. is three academic years
official.description: E-JUST offers the TICAD8 African Scholarships for STI to develop high quality human resources in the field of Science, Technology and Innovation toward a future African STI network and beyond, provided under the cooperation of the Egyptian government and JICA. The fully funded M.Sc. scholarships target researchers and instructors from African countries other than Egypt.
official.region: Egypt (New Borg El-Arab City, Alexandria); catalogue region: Middle East
official.program_type: Government-funded full scholarship for African nationals, delivered by a national university in cooperation with JICA
official.english_requirement: Full-time students: TOEFL iBT minimum 79 or Academic IELTS minimum 6.5, and the language certificate must be valid at the time of application submission. Provisionally accepted students: Duolingo English Test minimum 125, TOEFL iBT minimum 65 or Academic IELTS minimum 5.5, with mandatory registration for an English language course as part of the preparatory courses; they must reach TOEFL iBT 79 or Academic IELTS 6.5 within one academic year of enrolment or their enrolment will be terminated. Applicants whose native language is English, from countries where English is an official language, are exempt from submitting evidence of English proficiency.

applicant_utility.summary: This is E-JUST's fully funded M.Sc. award for African (non-Egyptian) researchers and instructors, run with JICA: tuition, on-campus accommodation, a monthly stipend, medical care and return airfare are all covered. You apply online through the international admission tab with a research proposal matched to one of five faculties (Engineering, Computer Science and IT, Basic and Applied Sciences, International Business and Humanities, Heritage Science), then face an online interview with a 15-minute proposal defence and need at least 60% to be accepted. The published Fall 2026 round closed on 15 February 2026, so target the next window and watch the deadlines page - E-JUST has also just launched the follow-on TICAD 9 scheme running September 2026 to September 2031.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Working or aspiring researchers and instructors from African countries other than Egypt with a strong B.Sc. record who need an M.Sc., can commit to full-time study in Alexandria, and intend to return to a home institution afterwards.
application_readiness_checklist: Check your B.Sc. against the academic background table of your chosen programme and confirm a CGPA of at least 3/4 (very good / second class upper)
Line up two professors or ex-advisers early, since two academic recommendation letters are mandatory
Write a research proposal in the exact research area you select on the form and prepare a PowerPoint for the 15-minute interview presentation
Book TOEFL iBT 79 / Academic IELTS 6.5 (or Duolingo 125 only if you accept provisional entry) while certificates are still valid
Download and complete the E-JUST designated Certificate of Health and Security Application forms
Request the signed and stamped endorsement letter from your home institution several weeks before the deadline
common_rejection_risks: B.Sc. background that does not match the chosen programme's academic background table
English certificate missing or expired at the time of application submission
Transcripts that do not display the grading system or are scanned on one side only
A research proposal that reads as borrowed web material, or scoring below 60% at the interview
Failing to obtain the Supreme Council of Universities equivalency or the Ministry of Interior security clearance after selection
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: E-JUST states that any costs incurred during the selection procedures - travel expenses, documents preparation (official papers, photos, visa application, etc.) and any other personal expenses - will NOT be covered and must be paid by the applicant.
document_audit: Your passport must be valid for at least two years from the date of application
The B.Sc. transcript must show the grading system and both front and back sides must be scanned
The B.Sc. graduation project must be submitted in full, not summarized, and is mandatory for Faculty of Engineering applicants
All credentials must be in English or accompanied by an official translation
Original documents submitted are never returned, so never send your only copies
The photo must be a 4x6 cm formal photo taken within the past six months
alerts: The published Fall 2026 deadline (15 February 2026) has already passed and no new dates were posted as of 10 October 2026 - monitor ejust.edu.eg/international-deadlines and the TICAD webinar announcements
E-JUST states that reasons for disqualification at any stage of the selection procedure will NOT be disclosed and that the schedule is subject to change

The award is full-time only: you may not work elsewhere during the scholarship period, and a semi-annual evaluation progress report (transcript, advisor report, research status) is sent to the sponsor
E-JUST announced the successor TICAD 9 African Scholarship and Postdoctoral Fellowship for STI in June 2026, so the TICAD8 terms may be replaced or renumbered in the next cycle
Egyptian nationals are excluded, and current military service disqualifies applicants
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Submit the online application with all documents before the posted deadline; E-JUST announces primary screening, runs the online interview and oral examinations, then follows the published sequence of result announcement, submission of original embassy-certified certificates, arrival, medical check-up, orientation and start of lectures.
